title: Blog post front matter
description: Contract every file under content/posts/ must satisfy. Automated authors (n8n) are validated against this in CI before a pull request can auto-merge.

title.description: Rendered as the H1 and the <title>. Capped at 70 characters because search engines truncate beyond that.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Becomes the permalink under /posts/, so it must never change once published.

date.description: Publication timestamp, RFC 3339 with an explicit offset.

lastmod.description: Last modification timestamp, RFC 3339 with an explicit offset.

description.description: Meta description and social card summary. Search engines show roughly 50-160 characters.

tags.description: Must all exist in data/tags.yaml. Checked separately by validate_content.py.

draft.description: Drafts are excluded from the production build.

weight.description: Lower values pin a post to the top of the list.

aliases.description: Old paths to redirect from. Required when a slug has to change after publication.

featureImage.description: Hero image. Relative to the page bundle.

xml.description: Set false to keep the post out of the sitemap and RSS.
